dossier_meta.statement_text: Given $n$ and $r$, what is the smallest value of $s$ for which $f(n,r,s)=g(n,r,s)$?
dossier_meta.context_text: After establishing that the functions $f$ and $g$ behave differently for $s\ll\frac{\sqrt{r}}{\log r}$ and similarly when $s\geq\sqrt{r\log r}$, the authors find it interesting to determine precisely when the two functions start to exhibit different behaviour; Question 4.3 is described as an explicit question in this direction.
